behaviorOnMain: A committed GM rewind reaches the live match and its connected players (FN-u22-rewind-commit-rebuild-never-reaches-the-live-match). (1) The rewind commit route (src/pages/api/matches/[id]/rewind-commit.ts:230) looks the live host up through getMatchHostRegistry, whose singleton is module-local (src/lib/multiplayer/server/MatchHostRegistry.ts:222-230), while server.js loads the socket runtime in a separate tsx module graph (server.js:445-465), so the API route sees an empty registry and the live rebuild never runs; the registry shares one instance through a globalThis symbol, as getDefaultMatchStore already does for the match store (getDefaultMatchStore.ts:31-41), and the doc comment at MatchHostRegistry.ts:223 is corrected. (2) After rebuildFromActivatedBranch, the players connected at that moment receive the rebuilt match without rejoining; today a rewind only marks viewers for resync and the resync runs on their next join (ServerMatchHost.ts:584-588, :903-908). Red-first: a jest row that loads the registry module in two isolated module graphs and shows two instances today; a host-level row where a connected viewer receives nothing after a rebuild today; E2E-25 through the privacy-pack ladder group as the live acceptance: on this unit's head E2E-25 becomes an unexpected pass (the strict test.fail stays; U22 removes it). If (2) needs an edit outside src/lib/multiplayer/server, the unit stops at admission for a path amendment. Amended 2026-09-23 (owner decision OD-u22a-replace-stream-marker, after the first admission attempt measured that connected clients block on a sequence collision once the rebuild reaches them): (3) ReplayStart carries a replace-stream marker; the client clears its delivery admission state on it and emits an event, and the session hook clears its event mirror on that event; the server moves the registry's recovery flag into the same globalThis slot as the registry, and after a committed rewind rebuilds the live host it replays each attached player's own projected view through the per-socket join path (viewer resolution, fog filter, publication guard; never one frame broadcast to every socket), stamping the marker after the publication guard. Clause (1) never ships without (2) and (3): the probe showed every connected client blocks on the next event otherwise.

design.protocol: ReplayStartSchema gains `replacesStream: z.literal(true).optional()`: present means "this replay replaces the stream you hold"; absent keeps today's meaning.
server: MatchHostRegistry: one Symbol.for("mekstation.multiplayer.matchHostRegistry") slot on globalThis holding { registry, recoveryRan }; getMatchHostRegistry, bootstrapMultiplayerServer and _resetMatchHostRegistry operate on the slot; the :223 comment says what the slot gives.

ServerMatchHost implements it: for each lifecycle.attachedSockets() entry, run the replay module's handleSessionJoin(ctx, socket, playerId, 0, matchId, replacesStream=true) with a context built after the session and ceiling were replaced, then clear that player's resync mark; a throw is logged and leaves the mark, so that viewer resyncs on its next join. Never broadcaster.broadcast.
sendReplay/handleSessionJoin (replay module) take replacesStream (default false) and stamp it on the guarded, delivery-stamped start frame only.
design.client: ReplayStart with replacesStream === true: pendingLiveEvents, the applied identity maps, blockedBySequenceCollision, lastSeq, lastAppliedDelivery, lastDeliverySequence, deliveryResumeCursor, the hole pins and highestAcknowledgedDelivery return to the values connect() starts with; pendingIntents, the socket, timers and recoveringFromGap are kept; then the client emits "streamReplaced". Without the marker the handler is unchanged.
design.hook: connectMultiplayerSession subscribes "streamReplaced" and clears the mirror log (setMirrorLog([])) before the replayed items are applied at ReplayEnd; useMultiplayerSession.ts and mirrorMatchSession.ts need no change by this design.
design.privacy: Each attached socket gets its own viewer's projection through the join path; the GM-private reason is not in the match event stream (rewind-commit.ts:208, :213-227); authority-only fields are removed for players by the projector (ViewerFrameProjector.ts:66-70, :196-209).
